_note: Game modes the demo offers. pack = packs/<pack>.json (null = free build, no game runtime). world = the starting world spec. Order = order of the picker cards.

modes.title: Free build
modes.about: Say a world, add anything, change the style. No enemies: just the open-world model.
try: a snowy mountain world at night

modes.title: Zombie survival
modes.about: Waves of zombies. Make weapons, towers and traps by saying them.

modes.title: Pirates vs sharks
modes.about: An island under attack: pirates from the beach, sharks in the water.

modes.title: Scavenger hunt
modes.about: I name a thing, you make it by saying it. 10 things, 30 seconds each.
